title: UAV Animation
text: Animate UAV flight path using translations and rotations, 5 inputs; {Number of UAVs} sets the number of UAV to display, {Enable dynamic UAV mesh configuration} sets the dynamic UAV mesh configuration, {UAV Type} sets the type of UAV mesh, {UAV size} sets the size of frames and attached meshes, {UAV mesh color} sets the color of UAV meshes, {UAV mesh and trajectory alpha} sets the transparency of UAV mesh and trajectory, {Inertial frame z-axis direction} sets the direction of positive z -axis of inertial frame, {Rotation format} sets the format of rotation, {Draw marker} enables markers and {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Rotation
ports.summary: Rotations of UAV body frames matrix | m -by-4 matrix

params.name: Number of UAVs
params.values: Number of UAV to display 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable dynamic UAV mesh configuration
params.values: Dynamic UAV mesh configuration off (default) | on

params.name: UAV Type
params.values: Type of UAV mesh to display Multirotor (default) | FixedWing

params.name: UAV size
params.values: Size of frames and attached meshes 1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: UAV mesh color
params.values: Color of UAV meshes [1 0 0] (default) | RGB triplet

params.name: UAV mesh and trajectory alpha
params.values: Transparency of UAV mesh and trajectory 1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Inertial frame z-axis direction
params.values: Direction of positive z -axis of inertial frame Down (default) | Up

params.name: Rotation format
params.values: Format of rotation input Quaternion (default) | Euler ZYX
